title: Brand Identity Design for UK Trade Businesses | MonoBook
description: Logo, colour, typeface, image style and brand guidelines for UK trade and service businesses. In one working day, seven days or fourteen.

h1: It just does not look like it does.
sub: One identity for your vans, signs, quotes and website.

lines: MonoBook, founded in 2022. Led by Mehedi Hasan, who started this work in 2016.

introApproval.text: If you pass all six, you do not need us.

questions: [VEHICLE], site board, quote sheet: same logo, same colours?
Is the logo on the [VEHICLE] readable from across the street?
Does the logo work in one colour on workwear?
Are your colour codes written down, or does each printer guess?
Does the logo alone tell people what you do?
blocks.under: Failed two or more? Send us your brief.

blocks.heading: Who this is for, and who it is not.
for: Firms that already trade and want one identity across vehicles, signs, quotes and website.
not: You want a website, advertising or social media posts. This package is five parts: logo, colour, typeface, image style and guideline. Anything beyond them is quoted separately.
You cannot approve work in writing as we go. We work in steps, and every approval is written.
blocks.line: Not sure which side you are on? Tell us what you need and we will say honestly whether we can help.

blocks.heading: You deal with the founder.
paras: Mehedi Hasan founded MonoBook in 2022 and started this work in 2016. He is your contact from the first email to the final file. The studio is in Satkhira, Bangladesh, and works with you by email and video call.
